title: Petition of Boston Edison Company for approval by the Department of Public Utilities, under the provisions of G.L. c. 92, § 43, that public convenience and necessity requires a location in a portion of a boulevard in the care and control of the Metropolitan District Commission in the City of Boston, namely, Soldiers Field Road, Brighton District, for the purpose of installing approximately 400 feet of conduit with the necessary cables therein, and to build a manhole in said boulevard.
